task.title: Signing in for the first time
task.shortdesc: Accept your invitation, set a password, and turn on two-step verification.

prereq.p: An administrator at your shelter must invite you first. Look for an email from with the subject "You're invited to join your shelter".

step.cmd: Open the invitation email and click Accept invitation.

info.p: Invitations expire after 7 days. If yours has expired, ask your administrator to resend it.

step.cmd: Enter your name and choose a password of at least 12 characters.

choices.choice: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
Or register a security key or passkey.

stepresult.p: You see 10 backup codes. Store them somewhere safe; each one works once if you lose your device.

result.p: The Today dashboard opens. It shows the animals, tasks and shifts that need your attention.

postreq.p: Install the app on your phone and sign in with the same account to work from the kennel floor.
